body.x: NEW YORK, USA (AVING) -- <Visual News> Panasonic has announced that it will begin shipping its world-largest 103-inch 1080p Full HD PDP TV in USA market for corporate use after receiving continuous inquiries about the model to be used for a broadcasting station or large-size information display. This model is also planned to be released in Japan and Europe market in addition to USA market by year-end.
This 103-inch world-largest PDP was proudly showcased at CES 2006 in Las Vegas, USA, catching lots of attention from the visitors. It measures 2.3x1.3m, which is four times bigger than 50-inch TV.

Panasonic expects to see demand for large-size 100-inch display go up as more HD and DVD content is coming out in the market. Panasonic started to ship the model in June in its third plant located in Amagasaki region in Japan and it aims to sell 5,000 units in global market this year. Meanwhile, 102-inch PDP TVs by Samsung and LG are already in the market.
